scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@plataforma/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@plataforma/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/shared && npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/api && npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/web
scripts.build:deploy: npm run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.build:hostinger: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/shared && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/api && npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@plataforma/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@plataforma/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@plataforma/web
